scope: Actual local Linux quality check and exact-byte preflight; not a GitHub run or deployed image
command: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --progress plain -f artifacts/local/rtl025-ci-context/Dockerfile.ci -t retailor/rtl025-ci:local artifacts/local/rtl025-ci-context

stress.rssMeasurement: Actual process RSS returned unchanged to the real production guard; maximum is sampled at admission, not a guaranteed peak

limitations: Local Debian container is not Ubuntu/GitHub hosted job acceptance
Private context uses exact Git-blob export plus ticket changes; original .git and ignored env/uploads/outputs are excluded
Ephemeral Git commit exists only within verification image; baselineRevision is the source baseline, not that fixture commit
Frozen install/base tooling can access package registries; unpaid tests prohibit external networking and preflight makes zero paid/network requests
No production threshold, test skip, low-RSS mock, local service mutation, paid call, push or deployment
